question: Which of the following is an example of a sol?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milk of magnesia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Milk of magnesia:**
 
• Milk of magnesia is a colloidal dispersion of magnesium hydroxide in water.
 
• It is a sol, which is a type of colloid where solid particles are dispersed in a liquid medium.
 
• The magnesium hydroxide particles are very small and remain suspended in the water, giving it a milky appearance.
 
• It is commonly used as an antacid and laxative.
 
• The particles in milk of magnesia do not settle easily due to their small size and the presence of stabilizing agents.
 
• The particle size of the suspended Mg(OH)2 is within the colloidal range.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Face cream:**
 
• Face cream is an emulsion, which is a mixture of two or more immiscible liquids (typically oil and water).
 
• Emulsions are different from sols, as they involve the dispersion of liquids in liquids.
 
• Face creams contain emulsifiers that stabilize the mixture and prevent the liquids from separating.
 
• They are designed to provide moisture and other beneficial ingredients to the skin.
 
• Face cream is a complex mixture of many different substances.
 
• The consistency of face cream is due to the emulsifiers present.
 
• **Foam:**
 
• Foam is a colloidal dispersion where gas bubbles are trapped within a liquid or solid.
 
• It is a type of dispersion known as a foam, not a sol.
 
• Examples of foams include whipped cream and shaving cream.
 
• Foams are characterized by their light and airy texture.
 
• The stability of a foam is dependent on the surface tension of the liquid.
 
• Foams can be either liquid or solid.
 
• **Rubber:**
 
• Rubber, in its raw form, can be a latex, which is a colloidal dispersion, but processed rubber is a solid polymer.
 
• Processed rubber is not a sol.
 
• Raw latex is a colloidal dispersion of polymer particles in a water based liquid.
 
• Vulcanized rubber is a solid material.
 
• Rubber is an elastic polymer.
 
• The properties of rubber are due to its long chain polymer structure.
